textualBasis: OT translated from the Masoretic Text with significant reference to the Dead Sea Scrolls and Septuagint where they provide textual clarity. NT translated from the eclectic critical Greek text (NA27/UBS4). Notable for its extensive translator footnotes documenting textual decisions.
